name: AI automation
description: Find explicit workflow evidence that may justify an automation conversation. A match is evidence to review, not an assertion that the company wants outside help.

evidenceRules.label: Manual reporting workflow
evidenceRules.suggestion: Explore reporting consolidation and automated data flows.
evidenceRules.question: Is reducing manual reporting part of this role's first-quarter remit?

evidenceRules.label: Manual reconciliation workflow
evidenceRules.suggestion: Explore automating reconciliation between business systems.
evidenceRules.question: Which reconciliation steps still require people to compare systems manually?

evidenceRules.label: Document processing workflow
evidenceRules.suggestion: Explore document intake, extraction, and routing automation.
evidenceRules.question: What happens between receiving a document and getting its data into your systems?

evidenceRules.label: Systems integration workflow
evidenceRules.suggestion: Explore reliable integrations between the systems named in the role.
evidenceRules.question: Where does information need to move between systems without a reliable integration today?
